title: Empathy about repeating last night’s story

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?

currentLearnerUtterance: I'm sorry you had to tell The doctor everything last night

should: Understand the acknowledgement in relation to Dana’s opening.
Allow a brief, ordinary response without starting the whole story again.
mustNot: Do not ask what this clear acknowledgement means.
Do not invent details of last night’s interview.
